$Comment: What a defender's Focus shares, in no set of its own: the Bulwark's row names it as its Parent. Kind is the oath
set's kind (TrackStances/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus.json: one at a time, and while it stands every hit its holder
deals is multiplied by 0.9). Its line is Health, 10 a step. Its Path's guard face grants no number: it opens
the ability mod that makes Guardian's Call last longer (AbilityMods/MMOSkillTree/Mastery/
Mmo_Focus_Bulwark_Path_Guard.json), so PathGuard is 0 and no guard grant is written.
LineBound, LinePlain, GuardPlain and GuardPair say which grant list the step generator writes for this kind
(Grants) and which it leaves out ($Comment, which the game ignores): the line is unbound Health and the guard
face writes none. Leave them as they are; the step generator's own comment says why.
